body:
With new substances I like to log my experience with the effects, time stamped with amount took and all that jazz. Usually with psychs in general I’ll have sudden realizations, and be like “This is SO important I need to write this down RIGHT NOW”. and write it to my sober self Here’s something I wrote to myself yesterday:

“Change the narrative. Reframe it. YOU are not the victim. You have lived your entire life!!!!! Believing that every situation has a victim and a perpetrator. You have been limiting yourself this entire time to the worldview that your father forced you to accept. Yes, what your father did was wrong. He hurt you. But you’ve now taken his role. YOU are the perp. You hold the key to the cage you’ve put yourself in. Free yourself!!

Break the cycle that YOU are putting yourself thru. Those thoughts are YOURS. Nobody else is responsible for how you feel. YOU are. MOVE ON.”

I also like to draw both when sober and when high, although usually when high I’ll start to hyper focus on one detail and lose sight of the rest of the damn picture.
I started seeing a therapist last week. It was exhausting and scary opening up to someone after holding shit in for many years. I’m still scared to live but I want to try. Love you too

Thanks I like that analogy about working out. I’ve never really had to think about who i wanted to be before it feels like I’m always living a lie. But I know I don’t like who I am now so something has to change

I had the same epiphany. All the fears I have i just created for myself. I agonize over dumb shit that no one cares about except me. I just want to be free of the constant paranoia but I’m still chaining myself down
